description: Composite figure mixing four SEM micrographs with one EBSD phase map. (a1–a4) are SEM images of the M2-IA medium-Mn, intercritically annealed sample at stepwise increasing magnification, annotated with yellow arrows naming coexisting phases: (a1), scale bar 200 µm, arrows label "α'+γ+α" (upper right) and "δ" (centre) over a banded, partly lamellar matrix dotted with black pores; (a2), scale bar 20 µm, arrows label "α'+γ", "δ" and "α"; (a3), scale bar 5 µm, arrows label "α+γ" and "α" on a fine lath/lamellar morphology; (a4), scale bar 3 µm, arrows label "α+γ" (twice, upper left region) and "α". Panel (b) is an EBSD phase map of the same M2-IA sample with a 5 µm scale bar, in which the orange-coded phase represents austenite (per caption) and the white background phase is ferrite, separated by black boundary lines; austenite forms elongated, banded and blocky regions threading between large ferrite grains. Together the panels argue that intercritical annealing of M2-IA leaves a multi-phase α+α'+γ+δ microstructure with retained austenite elongated in bands of several micrometres. No numeric phase fractions are printed on any panel.

subfigures.description: Low-magnification SEM image with a 200 µm scale bar; banded, partly lamellar matrix with small black pores. Yellow arrows label 'α'+γ+α' (upper right) and 'δ' (centre).
SEM image with a 20 µm scale bar of finer, elongated/lath-like features; yellow arrows label 'α'+γ' (upper), 'δ' (centre) and 'α' (lower right).
SEM image with a 5 µm scale bar showing a fine lath/lamellar morphology; yellow arrows label 'α+γ' (left) and 'α' (right).
Highest-magnification SEM image with a 3 µm scale bar; yellow arrows label 'α+γ' in the upper-left region (two labels) and 'α' in the lower-left region of the field.
EBSD phase map with a 5 µm scale bar: orange-coded phase (austenite, per caption) as elongated, banded and blocky regions within a white matrix phase (ferrite), delineated by black boundary lines.

observations.observation: Panel (a1) is an SEM image with a 200 µm scale bar whose yellow arrows label the phases 'α'+γ+α' and 'δ', indicating four coexisting phases in the M2-IA sample.
Panels (a1)–(a4) form a magnification series on the same M2-IA sample with printed scale bars of 200 µm, 20 µm, 5 µm and 3 µm respectively.
Panel (a2) (20 µm scale bar) is annotated 'α'+γ'', 'δ' and 'α', showing the same phase assemblage at a finer length scale.
Panels (a3) (5 µm) and (a4) (3 µm) are annotated 'α+γ' and 'α', showing a fine lath/lamellar α+γ morphology with α regions.
Panel (a1) shows black pore-like features and a banded, partly lamellar matrix at the lowest magnification.
Panel (b) is an EBSD phase map with a 5 µm scale bar in which the orange-coded phase occurs as elongated, banded and blocky regions inside a white matrix phase, separated by black boundary lines.
The caption states that in panel (b), the coloured phase (orange) represents austenite.
The caption states that panels (a1–a4) are SEM images of the M2-IA sample showing the presence of different phases.
No numeric austenite or ferrite phase fraction is printed on the EBSD phase map (b); the austenite content is only shown qualitatively by colour.
The sample investigated in this figure is labelled M2-IA, i.e. an intercritically annealed condition of the M2 medium-Mn steel.

measured_quantities: scale bar length (µm): 200, 20, 5 and 3 µm for SEM panels (a1)–(a4), 5 µm for EBSD map (b)
austenite phase distribution / area fraction from EBSD phase map (qualitative, no value printed)
